name: Building Tools
comment: Where Building Tools finds game code by its bytes, wherever Kiln has a symbol on those bytes (and two more: MissingCall, ScreenDispatch). It loads as a dinput8.dll proxy, a Kiln Library native mod or mods/building-tools/BuildingTools.dll (ShroudForge, XHL-Core), starts a thread from its DllMain, waits 4 s and scans the live code once (exact signatures; jump-tolerant ones accept another mod's jump in their first `head` bytes and chain to it), then redirects the game's calls to what it found. Kiln code on an exact signature's bytes when it scans turns that feature of Building Tools off. Every Kiln symbol on a scan's bytes is listed under `kiln` with what Kiln does there; OPEN marks a known conflict. tools/sigport/tests/test_foreign_scans.py checks this on the pinned executables (docs/kiln/engines/README.md, 'Mods that find game code by its bytes').

kiln.rules/CursorFlags: not hooked since 0.2.0-dev.31.13: the scope of rules/CursorFlagsStored (kiln-rules' cursor waivers hook at entry + 0xfa). Until then kiln-rules hooked this entry when it loaded, which hid the signature (XHL, 2026-11-25)

scans.name: MissingCall
scans.note: ends right before rules/CursorFlagsStored (+ 0xfa), where Kiln's patch starts

scans.name: ScreenDispatch
scans.feature: its menu (Home), tools wheel (Caps Lock) and exact placement window
scans.note: No Kiln code there. Creative Mode 3.2.0 rewrites + 7 (its hud.modeDispatch, for its own menu screen), after which Building Tools' fallback search finds nothing either: compat rules creative-mode-building-tools-hud-dispatch and creative-mode-building-tools-native-hud-dispatch warn when both run

scans.name: Stocks
scans.feature: creative building's full material list and partial area actions

kiln.tools/MaterialSelector: OPEN (not changed in 0.2.0-dev.31.13): kiln-tools hooks this entry when it loads on the client (the material filter of Kiln mods' building tools, and the ammo picker); Building Tools then logs 'full material list no' and 'partial area actions: not available'
kiln.build/client.MaterialRows: OPEN: kiln-items hooks the same entry once a player has a building link (crafting.build_ui), usually after Building Tools scanned

scans.name: UI_DRAW_HINTS
scans.feature: its menu, tools wheel and exact placement window (required by the menu)

kiln.ui/ChestFooter: OPEN (rare): kiln-core's native chest entries hook this entry when a mod first adds a chest button (Ui native chest entries); before Building Tools' scan (a mod adding one while it loads) its menu, wheel and exact window stay off, after it both work

kiln.ui/NativeTextLine: OPEN (rare): kiln-core's item-detail capture hooks this entry when a mod first reads an item's detail lines; before Building Tools' scan its menu stays off, after it both work

kiln.ui/NativeTextDraw: not hooked: Kiln's main-menu footer and item tooltips call it

scans.name: PlayUi
scans.feature: its menu (accepts another mod's jump at the start)

kiln.ui/PlayStateUi: not hooked: the scope of the gem forge's read-only checks (kiln-core) and of rules' UI patterns

scans.note: Building Tools also accepts this function with its first 0x12 bytes changed (find_play_ui); Greeneye's Hollow Halls Progression and The Worst Map Mod hook its entry

scans.name: PAY_PLACE
scans.feature: creative building's payment of a placement

kiln.build/BlueprintApplyRet: not hooked: the return address kiln-items compares ApplyMaterials' caller with. OPEN (other way round, from the code, not seen in a game): Building Tools redirects this call and the other building calls of ApplyMaterials (PayCost) to its own code, which then calls ApplyMaterials; Kiln's hook there sees Building Tools' code as the caller, so kiln-rules' building cost scaling (BuildCost, BuildRefund) and kiln-items' building-link payment, which recognise the building programs by that caller, would not apply while Building Tools runs

kiln.build/StockCount: not hooked: the call target kiln-items checks next to build/CursorStockRet (its mid hook is in the material check, not here)

kiln.stations/BaseStockForPlayer: not hooked: kiln-items calls it and checks its code before the crafting preview

kiln.rules/ApplyMaterials: hooked at its entry (kiln-rules' building costs, kiln-items' building links); Building Tools accepts a jump there (find_hookable, 7 bytes) and chains to it. See PAY_PLACE for what its redirected calls mean for Kiln's caller checks

scans.name: PlaceCommit
scans.feature: area placement (required: the mod turns off without it)

kiln.gameplay/PlaceBlueprint: hooked at its entry (kiln-gameplay); Building Tools accepts a jump there (find_hookable, 5 bytes) and chains to it

kiln.gameplay/DismantleBlock: hooked at its entry (kiln-gameplay); Building Tools accepts a jump there (find_hookable, 5 bytes) and chains to it

kiln.items/IterBegin: hooked at its entry; Building Tools accepts a jump there (find_hookable, 5 bytes) and chains to it
